title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Owned-Building Account Factor for Commercial Placements
content:
### Scope
Commercial placements priced under the commercial placement schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** (Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building tier), for lenders that also insure buildings of their own with Tidemark under the **NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)**.

### Rule
Owned-building account factor for a commercial placement: the rated amount of a commercial placement is multiplied by 0.92 when the premium payments the lender made in the last 12 months on its own NFIP General Property Form or RCBAP policies with Tidemark total 15000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 24 months or more; by 0.96 when those payments total 5000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 12 months or more, but the payments are below 15000 dollars or the program has been in force fewer than 24 months; and by 1.00 in every other case.

### Records and counting
- Payments: the premium payment entries received on the policies the lender itself holds under that product, both General Property Form and RCBAP, dated by the day each payment was received.
- Months in force for a commercial placement are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached; a window of the last 12 months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 12 such whole months have passed by today.

### Condition combinations
| Payments of 15000 dollars or more | Payments of 5000 dollars or more | In force 24 months or more | In force 12 months or more | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes | 0.92 |
| yes | yes | no | yes | 0.96 |
| no | yes | yes or no | yes | 0.96 |
| any | any | no | no | 1.00 |
| no | no | any | any | 1.00 |
